qualificationQuestions: Is your heating or cooling system completely unresponsive?

faq.q: What should I do if I smell natural gas or burning?
faq.a: Leave the house immediately, do not turn on any light switches, and call 911 or your gas utility from outside. We can inspect the equipment once cleared.

faq.q: How fast can a tech arrive?
faq.a: For emergency no-heat calls in freezing weather, average dispatch response is under 90 minutes.
